note: Cutout rig for 03 (line defense, unit 104px = native/3). 4 drawings, all rigid: torso (backpack painted on), head (helmet painted on), arm (BOTH arms + rifle as one piece, pivot = near shoulder; far arm copy hidden by 'single'), leg (used twice). Proportions measured on source/template_cut/gpt/rifleman_motions.png idle-1 / shoot-aim cells (chibi: head ~40% of height, sheet 195px tall x1.6 = native 312). 12fps stepped clips.

slots.name: torso
slots.note: side view, chest right, backpack on the left (back). No arms painted. Standing collar hides the neck stub (head drawn behind). Belt + pouches at y~45, tunic hem covers the hip joints

slots.name: head
slots.note: head WITH helmet painted on, face looks right, neck stub at the bottom. pivot = neck base

slots.name: arm
slots.note: near arm from the shoulder (pivot) to the pistol grip + far arm on the fore-end + the rifle, one rigid piece, muzzle right. Rotates at the shoulder: aim up / lower for reload

slots.name: leg
slots.note: hip (pivot) to boot sole, boot toe right, straight stubby leg

units._note: body size x regular(104px). small 80 -> 0.77, huge 136 -> 1.31 (idea doc 유닛 크기). theme name <unit>_<era> maps by the part before '_'
